_comment: Symbols are ticker symbols, read by Yahoo and by Schwab alike. `symbols` is the morning report: what you actually look at before the open, so keep it short enough to read. `practice` is the replay library the practice terminal draws from, and wants to be as long as you can afford -- a pool you cannot get familiar with is the whole point. Option quotes are recorded for `symbols` only, since they are the expensive part; use --symbols on tools/record-options.mjs to narrow that further.
